# Squish Finder

> Squish Finder (squishfinder.ca) is a free, fan-made "Which Squishmallow are you?" personality quiz. Six quick questions about colors, snacks, seasons and vibe match you, or someone you're shopping for, to one of 24 Squishmallows. It also has a Squishmallow gift guide and a profile page for every squish with its bio, personality, collector and rarity notes, size tips and where to buy. Free, no sign-up. Not affiliated with Jazwares or Squishmallows.

Updated: 2026-11-17

## Main pages

- [Which Squishmallow Are You? quiz](https://squishfinder.ca/): the 6-question personality quiz; choose "It's a gift" to find a Squishmallow for someone else
- [Gift quiz](https://squishfinder.ca/?gift=1): starts the quiz in gift mode
- [Squishmallow Gift Guide 2026](https://squishfinder.ca/squishmallow-gift-guide): gift picks by personality, favorite color and interest, plus which size to buy
- [Free Squishmallow Coloring Pages](https://squishfinder.ca/squishmallow-coloring-pages): 24 free printable colouring sheets of the fan-drawn squishes, one per page
- [All Squishmallows](https://squishfinder.ca/squishes/): all 24 squishes with bios, squads and links to their profiles

## Quick facts

- Squishmallows commonly come in 5", 8", 12", 16" and 24" sizes. 5" to 8" suits stockings and backpacks, 12" is the classic gift size, 16" to 24" is a huggable pillow.
- Rare editions are marked on the tag: silver (Rare), gold (Ultra Rare) and black (Select Series), plus event exclusives such as Comic-Con editions.
- Squish Finder's bios and illustrations are original fan work.
